title: A single-covariate benchmark against omitted composite structure
question: Does the bias from dropping the strongest measured covariate bound the residual bias from several omitted variables, and does a scaled benchmark calibrate?
design: Unanchored binary-outcome MAIC with four measured covariates and one, three or six correlated omitted covariates of varying strength; leave-one-covariate-out benchmark, unscaled and scaled by sqrt(q), by the oracle correlation-adjusted factor and by q; coverage of the true residual bias. 21 cells, 1000 replicates each.
